designationHistory.name: Hawaiian Islands Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt set aside the islets and reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian chain, from Nihoa (Bird Island) to Kure (Cure Island), as the Hawaiian Islands Reservation for native birds by Executive Order 1019.
designationHistory.note: Machine OCR of the FWS copy misreads the date as February 2; the page image reads February 3, 1909, No. 1019. Renamed Hawaiian Islands National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940. Signed one month before T.R. left office.
